skills.text: Relevance judgement programme, query log analysis, ranking rule proposal, limitation documentation, batch coordination with relevance judges.
skills.witness: Search quality analyst on a knowledge search product for three years, measuring search quality through the relevance judgement programme under the team's measurement standard with monthly judgement batches. Analysed the query logs for failure patterns each week and prepared the weekly quality report for the search product manager, with the reports filed in the search quality folder. Proposed nineteen ranking rule changes with their expected effect on the quality metrics; each was approved or declined by the search product manager, recorded on the proposal. Coordinated the judgement batches with the six relevance judges through the batch schedule, recording which batch designs were mine and which followed the standard templates. Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each ranking rule proposal for the ranking engineers.
